# Type-Only Function: fromPlugin

```ts
declare function fromPlugin<const T extends readonly Dependency[], V, M extends PluginAcquisition>(dependencies: T & DependencyTupleAdmission<T>, plugin: unknown, options: PluginOptions<M, V>): PluginResult<T, V, M>;
```

Type-only package export. Import it with `import type { fromPlugin } from 'di-bag'` and refer to its callable shape as `typeof fromPlugin`. Call the runtime API as `DiBag.fromPlugin`.

Defined in: [plugins.ts:78](https://github.com/dany-fedorov/di-bag/blob/main/src/plugins.ts#L78)

Validate an unknown plugin descriptor and its output at a declared dependency boundary.
The descriptor must have own `apiVersion: 1` and callable `create`, with an optional
callable `dispose`. A disposer owns the original acquired value before validation.

## Returns

A lazy provider that validates its output when acquired.
